[b][size=xx-large][color=#ffffff][u]Hack Forum News - Edition 34[/u][/color][/size][/b]

[b]Welcome back to the Hack Forum News. Where we keep you up to date on the weekly events and news happening on site and around the world. If you have never heard of the Hack Forum News, don't worry, we have you covered. We are a team of members from the Hack Forums community who are journalists and writers, and we are here to keep you in the loop of the changes around the site and the events happening around the world.[/b]

[u][b][size=large][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6318027][color=#ffffff]Guests View First Post Only[/color][/url][/size][/b][/u] By [mention=1]

This week [mention=1] has been fixing a few bugs regarding the new feature which allows guests to view first posts in threads. The bug in question allowed guests to view pages if they somehow managed to get the post ID. This bug has now been fixed and is no longer possible for guests to view any posts and only the post first made on the thread.

[u][b][size=large][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6314337][color=#ffffff]The Hack Forums Wiki Returns[/color][/url][/size][/b][/u] By [mention=2331053]

The Hack Forums Wiki has returned. The site has been under some work recently as the site was sadly left with a load of issues and no one was running the official site. Thanks to everyone within the HF news team, the site is now under new leadership and, thanks to [mention=1] allowing the team to start their work on this while maintaining the HF news, the site is back getting some lovely changes and getting updated daily to bring it back to a new modern day Wikipedia with a load of information for everyone to read up on.

[color=#C10300][b][size=15]The Male Reset Button: Inside the Refractory Period[/size][/b][/color]

The refractory period is a normal physiological phase that occurs after ejaculation, during which a man is temporarily unable to achieve another erection or orgasm.

This phase is controlled by the nervous system and involves several hormonal and chemical changes in the body.

After ejaculation, the brain releases neurotransmitters such as serotonin and hormones like prolactin, which reduce sexual arousal and promote relaxation.

At the same time, blood flow to the penis decreases, leading to loss of erection.

This process protects the body from overstimulation and allows the reproductive system to recover.

The length of the refractory period varies greatly between individuals. Younger men may recover within minutes, while older men may require hours or longer.

Factors such as overall health, stress levels, physical fitness, emotional connection, and frequency of sexual activity can all influence recovery time.

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]Apollo and xAI near $3.4B deal to fund Nvidia chips for AI hardware buildouts[/color][/size][/b][/u]
Apollo Global Management is close to finalizing a $3.4 billion loan to an investment vehicle that will buy Nvidia chips and lease them to Elon Musk’s xAI to support massive AI compute infrastructure expansion.  
[b][url=https://www.reuters.com/business/apollo-xai-near-34-billion-deal-fund-ai-chips-information-reports-2026-02-09/]Source[/url][/b]

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]Lenovo warns gamers to buy hardware soon as PC component prices rise[/color][/size][/b][/u]
A Lenovo executive advised gamers and PC buyers to purchase hardware now before current stock prices rise further, as ongoing memory and GPU shortages push up costs.  
[b][url=https://www.wccftech.com/lenovo-sounds-the-alarm-for-gamers-urging-hardware-purchases-as-soon-as-possible/]Source[/url][/b]

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]Samsung stock rises as next generation HBM4 memory production nears launch[/color][/size][/b][/u]
Samsung Electronics shares climbed after reports stated the company is preparing to begin mass production of advanced high-bandwidth memory 4 (HBM4) chips this month for use in AI processors.  
[b][url=https://www.barrons.com/articles/samsung-chips-micron-stock-price-be88fd2a]Source[/url][/b]

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]Micron stock falls on concerns over HBM4 supply for Nvidia AI hardware[/color][/size][/b][/u]
Micron Technology’s shares dropped as worries spread that its HBM4 memory chips may not be included in Nvidia’s upcoming Vera Rubin AI GPU launch, driving investor uncertainty.  
[b][url=https://www.marketwatch.com/story/microns-stock-falls-on-fears-about-nvidias-new-chips-but-investors-may-be-overreacting-45b8f066]Source[/url][/b]

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]HP, Dell, Acer and Asus consider Chinese memory chips amid supply crunch[/color][/size][/b][/u]
Major PC makers including HP, Dell, Acer and Asus are looking at sourcing memory chips from Chinese manufacturers due to global shortages, which could help mitigate rising costs and launch delays.  
[b][url=https://www.reuters.com/world/china/hp-dell-acer-asus-mull-using-chinese-memory-chips-amid-supply-crunch-nikkei-asia-2026-02-05/]Source[/url][/b]

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]Intel and AMD notify Chinese customers of lengthy CPU delivery waits due to supply constraints[/color][/size][/b][/u]
Intel warned of lead times up to six months for some server CPUs in China, with AMD also reporting extended waits, reflecting persistent supply chain shortages in core server hardware.  
[b][url=https://www.reuters.com/world/china/intel-amd-notify-customers-china-lengthy-waits-cpus-2026-02-06/]Source[/url][/b]

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]AI led memory shortage may push up prices for phones, PCs and TVs in 2026[/color][/size][/b][/u]
A global supply squeeze driven by AI server demand is raising costs for DRAM and NAND memory, potentially making consumer electronics like phones, TVs and PCs more expensive this year.  
[b][url=https://www.business-standard.com/technology/tech-news/ai-led-memory-shortage-threatens-to-make-phones-tvs-pcs-costlier-in-2026-126020900349_1.html]Source[/url][/b]

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]Global semiconductor industry on track to reach $1 trillion in sales in 2026[/color][/size][/b][/u]
The global semiconductor industry recorded nearly $800 billion in sales in 2025 and is expected to exceed $1 trillion in 2026, driven by AI, autonomous tech and IoT hardware demand.  
[b][url=https://www.tomshardware.com/tech-industry/semiconductors/semiconductor-industry-on-track-to-hit-usd1-trillion-in-sales-in-2026-sia-predicts-bumper-forecast-follows-usd791-7-billion-haul-for-2025]Source[/url][/b]
